2026-10-30-spell-ingredients.title: Spell ingredients
2026-10-30-spell-ingredients.body: Spells can require material components: costly ones (with a gp value) or consumed ones. Battles check them on the hero and spend them on cast, and a shortage can be paid from the purse. The DM sets components in the spell form and turns the rule on in Rules; the cast dialog shows what is required and what is missing.

2026-10-30-empty-5e.title: Empty D&D 5e campaign
2026-10-30-empty-5e.body: In the new campaign wizard the "5e (empty)" template is selected by default: D&D 5e rules (classes with levels, saving throws, d20 initiative) with no ready-made content. You add classes, races, spells and monsters yourself. "No template" remains for campaigns with their own rules.

2026-10-30-ability-recipes.title: Recipes and collapsible sections
2026-10-30-ability-recipes.body: Adding an ability or a spell effect now starts from a gallery of recipes: pick a ready-made effect (damage, healing, buff, condition and more), set its parameters and see a preview. Sections of the ability editor collapse and show a short summary, and so does the Effects section of the spell form.

2026-10-30-ai-reading.title: Reading long scenarios and micro NPCs
2026-10-30-ai-reading.body: On large pages the assistant now reads the scenario in parts and can find every mention of a character in any grammatical form. It can propose a new micro NPC and link all their mentions at once; applying creates the acquaintance and turns the names into chips.

2026-10-29-compendium-images.title: Images in compendium import
2026-10-29-compendium-images.body: The compendium import now downloads images from the file (unit portraits, spell and item icons, book and adventure pictures) into our storage after you confirm, with a progress bar and a report of what was skipped. Failed images can be retried.

2026-10-29-compendium-import-guide.title: Compendium import: steps, hint and help
2026-10-29-compendium-import-guide.body: The JSON compendium import screen now has a step indicator (file, categories, check, confirm), a hint and a help article about the report and why an import is blocked.

2026-10-29-spell-attack-crits.title: Spell attack crits and fumbles
2026-10-29-spell-attack-crits.body: The DM's choice for natural 20s and 1s now also applies to spell attacks, including automatic reactions (such as Rageful Nimbus): the battle waits for your pick, and "Cancel action" cancels the whole attack.

2026-10-29-spell-editor-forms.title: Editor for every spell effect
2026-10-29-spell-editor-forms.body: The spell editor now has forms for all special effects (choose one, sub-cast, aura on a target, summon, transform, terrain). On the Rules page you can delete campaign custom conditions; if a condition is still in use, you will see where.

2026-10-29-summons-and-transform.title: Summoned objects and transformation
2026-10-29-summons-and-transform.body: Spells can summon immobile objects on the map (guardian bushes automatically attack enemies nearby, and the caster can strike with them as a bonus action) and transform a beast into a campaign unit: the form has its own HP, and when the form drops to zero the creature returns to its normal shape, carrying over the excess damage. Objects and the form vanish with the duration or when concentration is lost.

2026-10-29-spell-zones.title: Difficult terrain and spell zones
2026-10-29-spell-zones.body: Spells can place difficult terrain, fog and walls on the map: moving through difficult terrain costs twice as much, and attacks in fog have disadvantage. Zones pull back those who leave, an aura on a target affects everyone nearby, and distant strikes (a swarm of paper birds) arrive at the start of the caster's turn. The DM paints difficult terrain with the "Difficult" brush.

2026-10-29-temporary-spell-actions.title: Temporary actions from spells
2026-10-29-temporary-spell-actions.body: Spells can grant separate action tiles for their duration (hurl a cone, strike with a blade, a shell claw), charges of extra damage for the next hits, a grasp that deals damage at the start of a turn, and an automatic reaction when an enemy attacks a marked target. The tile vanishes with the duration or when concentration is lost and does not spend a slot.

2026-10-28-acquaintances.title: Acquaintances
2026-10-28-acquaintances.body: The DM selects an NPC's name in the scenario text and turns it into an acquaintance: name, portrait, description and an encounter journal. Players see it as soon as the DM marks the scene as played, and can keep their own notes. The DM enables the section in the campaign settings.

2026-10-28-notifications.title: "New" notifications
2026-10-28-notifications.body: When the DM raises a level or hands out an item or spell, you get a notification, and the tile or item gets a golden "new" mark. It disappears as soon as you open the matching tab.

2026-10-28-arcane-recovery.title: Wizard's Arcane Recovery
2026-10-28-arcane-recovery.body: The wizard's sheet now has an Arcane Recovery panel: once a day after a short rest you can restore spell slots within the circle budget.

2026-10-28-cunning-strike.title: Cunning Strike in attacks
2026-10-28-cunning-strike.body: In the attack dialog the Rogue picks a Cunning Strike effect (poison, trip, withdraw) and spends Sneak Attack dice on it.

2026-10-28-reckless-steady.title: More accurate Reckless Attack and Steady Aim
2026-10-28-reckless-steady.body: Reckless Attack applies only to Strength attacks; Steady Aim requires the hero not to have moved and is spent by the first attack.

2026-10-28-proficiencies.title: Proficiencies from races, feats and multiclassing
2026-10-28-proficiencies.body: Armor and weapon proficiencies now come from races and feats, and multiclassing adds only what the 5e rules table allows.

2026-10-28-class-map.title: Class map
2026-10-28-class-map.body: A class shows what it grants at each level: abilities, subclass, choices and numbers. The DM sees the map in the class editor; the player sees it on the hero sheet (current level, next level, open choices) and in the level-up dialog.

2026-10-28-official-templates.title: Campaign templates
2026-10-28-official-templates.body: In the new campaign wizard you can start from an official template: 5e SRD 5.2 with 5e rules and content, Heroes with factions, units and spells, or an empty campaign (the "No template" option). Template updates are pulled in via "Update from template".

2026-10-28-tokens-5e.title: Icons in the SRD 5.2 template
2026-10-28-tokens-5e.body: Units, spells and artifacts of the SRD template have their own images; campaigns receive them through "Update from template".

2026-10-28-world-rest.title: Resting on the world map
2026-10-28-world-rest.body: The DM rests the party from the travel panel: heroes' resources are restored according to the campaign rules, and the rest is recorded in the journal.

2026-10-28-puzzle.title: Puzzle in Show
2026-10-28-puzzle.body: The DM adds an image as a puzzle and picks the cut style and number of pieces. Players assemble it together on the show screen: a piece can be rotated, and a piece someone else has picked up is marked with their name.

2026-10-28-world-map.title: World map
2026-10-28-world-map.body: The DM moves heroes across the continent map and shows it to players, each with their own fog. There are notes for locations, and in the scenario rows and chapters can be linked to places on the map.

2026-10-28-crit-choice.title: DM picks the crit effect
2026-10-28-crit-choice.body: In campaign settings there is a "DM picks crit/fumble effects" option: on a natural 20 or 1 the battle waits until you choose an effect from a list. Crits can now also happen on targets' saving throws against spells; without the option the effect is random.

2026-10-28-book-conditions.title: Book conditions in campaign rules
2026-10-28-book-conditions.body: Compendium import carries the book's custom conditions (for example, "Pacified") into the campaign rules: spells that apply them now work in battle. A pacified creature does not attack, cast hostile spells or deal damage; a repeated saving throw at the end of its turn removes the condition, and the DM can remove it manually.

2026-10-28-spell-options.title: Spell option choice and fall height
2026-10-28-spell-options.body: Spells with options to choose from ask you to pick an option in the cast dialog, and spells like fall ask you to enter a height; the dice are calculated automatically. Damage by distance and pushback have been added.

2026-10-27-dashboard.title: New campaign dashboard
2026-10-27-dashboard.body: Sections are grouped and there is a section search. The DM sees "What's next": approvals, recent scenario pages and prepared battles. The player gets their hero card and a "To battle" button.

2026-10-27-inventory.title: Hero inventory
2026-10-27-inventory.body: "Items" and "Summary" are now a single "Inventory" tab: slots with silhouettes, a backpack, a wallet. On desktop you can drag items between the backpack and slots; on a phone, tap and pick an action.

2026-10-27-search.title: Search in lists
2026-10-27-search.body: Spells, races, artifacts, sets, skills, heroes and battles now have a search field by name.

2026-10-23-monsters-full.title: 5e monsters: breaths, spells, lair
2026-10-23-monsters-full.body: Stat blocks with senses and movement modes, at-will and recharge spells, legendary actions with targeting, and lair actions. Exact circle and emanation are available for 5e areas.

2026-10-23-feats-choices.title: 5e feats and choices
2026-10-23-feats-choices.body: Race lines (Elf, Gnome, Tiefling, Dragonborn, Goliath), feats (ASI capped at 20, fighting styles, epic boons), metamagic, cantrips, expertise and spells from class lists - in the hero form, on level-up and on the sheet ("Unchosen choices").

2026-10-23-magic-items.title: 5e magic items
2026-10-23-magic-items.body: Properties ("Flame Tongue", "Weapon +1") are granted together with the base item, ordinary gear is non-unique, plus attunement, charges that recharge on rest and consumable potions in battle. The SRD 5.2 template has 32 properties and 248 items.

2026-10-22-onboarding.title: First steps and help
2026-10-22-onboarding.body: The campaign page has a first-steps checklist, screens have hints, and the menu has a help section.

2026-10-22-player-drafts.title: Hero drafts from players
2026-10-22-player-drafts.body: A player creates a hero draft themselves with portrait generation, and the DM approves it or sends it back. The new "Summary" tab holds the hero's money, items and journal.

2026-10-21-ranged.title: Ranged combat
2026-10-21-ranged.body: Obstacles on the line of fire give cover automatically; chain shot and melee cleave have been added.

2026-10-21-manuscript.title: Scenario manuscript
2026-10-21-manuscript.body: The scenario is now a manuscript: links to slides and battles above the text, a table of contents for chapters and a placeholder for players.

2026-10-20-ai.title: AI assistant
2026-10-20-ai.body: Connect your own Claude, OpenAI or Gemini key - the assistant suggests scenario edits and helps during play.
